A city street with pedestrians in the background and storefronts lining both sides.

Every defined subject keeps exactly the appearance of its own reference image throughout the video, unchanged and identical on both sides of every cut, without drifting, morphing, or exchanging anything with another subject, and each defined subject appears exactly once in any frame, with no duplicate or leftover copy visible at the same time. Only these two are visible; no other figure appears in frame. <Subject 1> has his head turned slightly to look over his right shoulder while walking forward, his gaze fixed on something behind him rather than straight ahead. His shoulders are relaxed and his arms swing naturally at his sides as he walks. He does not see <Subject 2> until their bodies make contact. The moment of impact is sudden: <Subject 1>'s left shoulder brushes against <Subject 2>'s right side, causing both to stumble slightly forward. <Subject 1> immediately pivots on his planted foot and turns his torso toward her, his eyes widening as he registers the collision. His eyebrows lift slightly and his mouth opens in a brief expression of surprise before softening into an apology. He steps back half a pace with his right foot while keeping his left foot planted to stabilize himself. <Subject 2> steadies herself by shifting her weight onto her left leg, her arms coming up briefly for balance before dropping back down to her sides. She turns fully toward him, her expression softening from surprise into amusement — her eyebrows raise slightly at the inner corners and the corners of her mouth curve upward as she begins to speak. The camera tracks forward with <Subject 1> while simultaneously panning left to keep both subjects in frame after the collision, maintaining a medium framing that captures their upper bodies fully. As they begin talking, the camera holds steady on them at the same distance, allowing natural interaction space between them. <Subject 1> says: [English] "Oh, sorry, I wasn't paying attention." His jaw drops slightly as he speaks and his eyebrows knit together briefly in genuine apology before relaxing again. <Subject 2> responds with a warm smile that reaches her eyes — the corners crinkle slightly and her mouth forms a gentle curve as she says: [English] "No, it's fine, I wasn't paying attention either." Her voice carries a light, amused tone and her shoulders relax completely after speaking. She lets out a soft giggle through her nose with her head tilting slightly to the side, her eyes crinkling at the corners as she laughs briefly before returning to a friendly, relaxed expression. The camera remains steady throughout their exchange, holding them in a comfortable medium framing that captures both their faces clearly and allows for natural body language. By the end of the shot <Subject 1> has fully turned toward <Subject 2>, standing about an arm's length away from her with his hands at his sides, while <Subject 2> stands facing him with a relaxed posture and a warm, amused expression on her face.

overall_soundscape:
The ambient hum of city street life — distant traffic, faint chatter from passersby in the background, and the soft rustle of fabric as they bump. The sound of their footsteps is audible but not prominent, blending naturally with the environment. Their voices are clear and intimate despite being outdoors, with <Subject 1>'s apology carrying a slightly breathy quality and <Subject 2>'s response having a warm, melodic tone that carries the soft giggle through her voice.
